skill_name: Text summarization of the following article in less than 10 sentences.
workflow: The pandemic has resulted in an increased demand for digital services and a shift to e-commerce. To meet this demand, cloud-based services are being utilized to scale operations, manage workloads, and improve customer experience. Additionally, AI and automation tools have allowed companies to stay agile and productive. Cloud computing and AI were popular prior to the pandemic but are now becoming even more heavily utilized.
